summary: Retest of iteration 27 safety issues 1, 2, 4 and 7, plus a quick regression, using real sender<->viewer calls at 375x667 with a separate browser context per role. All 4 fixes pass. BACKEND: 11/11 pytest pass (test_reports_safety.py, 2 new tests). Mongo has the indexes reports.pair (unique on reporter_device + reported_device), reports.reported, and suspended.device (unique). The same reporter twice counts once; 2 distinct reporters give suspended=false; 3 distinct give true. 8 parallel reports from the same pair all return 200 with no 500. A direct duplicate insert raises DuplicateKeyError. The 6th report in a minute returns 429. ISSUE 1: a suspended sender sees sender-suspended-banner ('Account sospeso: è stato segnalato da più utenti…') right after the screen loads, and it is still there 4s later. sender-status now stays 'Account sospeso…' and is no longer overwritten by 'Camera pronta'. A suspended viewer sees viewer-suspended-banner on load. A device that is not suspended shows no banner. ISSUE 4: after a viewer block, the call ends, viewer-safety-msg 'Utente bloccato: non potrà più chiamarti.' stays visible, and a new code is created. After a sender block, the call ends and sender-safety-msg 'Codice 250884 bloccato: non potrai più chiamarlo per errore.' stays visible. Calling that code again gives 'Hai bloccato questo codice: non puoi chiamarlo.' ISSUE 7: the welcome checkboxes have role=checkbox and aria-checked that changes correctly (false->true->false). The accept button is aria-disabled until both are ticked, and accept stores terms_v1 and goes to /. REGRESSION: a normal call connects on both sides. Recording consent: the viewer records (Pro), the sender sees sender-rec-consent, allow shows sender-peer-rec-banner and the viewer shows 'Ferma 00:02', and stop removes the banner. Report sheet: 5 reasons, and sending gives 'Segnalazione inviata. Grazie!'. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

ui_bugs.issue: When the viewer is suspended, the banner shows, but viewer-status still says 'In attesa di chiamata.' and a shareable code (viewer-code + ShareCode) is shown. This is confusing because the account can't receive calls. Consider hiding or disabling the code and share actions, and setting the status to the suspended text (as the sender does).
sender-call-button stays enabled while suspended. Tapping it only shows the status text. Consider disabled={suspended}.

useSafety msg is never cleared (Safety.tsx:44). 'Segnalazione inviata' or 'Utente bloccato' stays under the status through all later calls in the same screen session. Consider clearing it when a new call starts or connects.

issues: The message appears twice: viewer-status already says 'Utente bloccato: non potrà più chiamarti. Ho creato anche un nuovo codice.' and viewer-safety-msg repeats 'Utente bloccato: non potrà più chiamarti.' right below it.
